|[[File:Map clue Clocktower.png|200px]]
|Search the crate by the [[Clock Tower (building)|Clock Tower]], south-west of [[East Ardougne]]. Using a [[Spirit tree]] to [[Battlefield of Khazard]] is the fastest route. [[Ardougne cloak 1|Ardougne cloak]]'s Monastery Teleport is also close by.
|[[File:Map clue solution Clocktower.png|250px]]
|-
|[[File:Map clue McGrubors.png|200px]]
|Inside [[McGrubor's Wood]], west of [[Seers' Village]]. [[Fairy ring]] code {{Fairycode|ALS}}. If approaching from outside, squeeze through the broken fence by the northern half of the hut in the centre and search the crate south of the house.
|[[File:Map clue solution McGrubors.png|250px]]
|-
|[[File:Map clue Lighthouse peninsula.png|200px]]
|Road between [[Rellekka]] and the [[Lighthouse]]. Fairy code {{Fairycode|alp}} and run East.
|[[File:Map clue solution Lighthouse peninsula.png|250px]]
|-
|[[File:Map clue Lava chaos altar.png|200px]]
|By the entrance to the [[Ourania Cave]]. Use the spirit tree to the Khazard Battlefield, or teleport to [[Castle Wars]] with a [[Ring of dueling]] and run North past the [[Observatory]].
|[[File:Map clue solution Lava chaos altar.png|250px]]

|[[File:Map clue Mort Myre.png|200px]]
|South of the path to [[Mort'ton]]; [[fairy ring]] {{Fairycode|BIP}} is nearby (50 [[Agility]] is required when you use the fairy ring).
|[[File:Map clue solution Mort Myre.png|250px]]
|-
|[[File:Map clue Tower of Life.png|200px]]
|Just south of [[East Ardougne]] (straight south of town square), north of the [[Tower of Life (building)|Tower of Life]], near the [[Necromancer's Tower]]. Dig two spaces north of the smaller crate that [[Bonafido]] is leaning on. [[Fairy ring]] code {{Fairycode|DJP}} is very close, or use any [[Ardougne cloak 1|Ardougne cloak]] to the [[Ardougne Monastery|Monastery]].
|[[File:Map clue solution Tower of Life.png|250px]]
|-
|[[File:Map clue Miscellania.png|200px]]
|On [[Miscellania]], one of the [[Fremennik]] Isles, just east of the castle. [[Fairy ring]] code {{Fairycode|CIP}} accessible only after completing [[The Fremennik Trials]].
|[[File:Map clue solution Miscellania.png|250px]]
